individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial heatmap showing deconvolution scores per spot on tissue, not an averaged summary plot requiring individual point overlay.
Box plots for each immune cell population have individual data points (jittered dots) overlaid on top of the boxes.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, exempt from requiring individual data points.
Bar graph shows log2 fold change values per gene (derived from DEG analysis, likely averaged across replicates) without individual data points overlaid.
Panel consists of micrographs (H&E and IHC images), not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - spatial heatmap panel does not display error bars or box-plot elements.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; ... (minima=..., median=..., maxima=..., Q1=..., Q3=...)
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - caption defines the box plot elements (25th-75th percentile box, with minima, median, maxima, Q1, Q3 values reported for each group).
not needed - GSEA enrichment line plots do not contain error bars.
not needed - bar graph does not display error bars.
not needed - micrograph panel, no error bars applicable.
